title: Kitten dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='15' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='38,30 34,15 46,25' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <polygon points='62,30 66,15 54,25' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <polygon points='39,28 36,19 44,25' fill='#f78fb3'/>
  <polygon points='61,28 64,19 56,25' fill='#f78fb3'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='38' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#2d2d6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='38' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#2d2d6b'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#b8e0ff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#b8e0ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='50,44 48,47 52,47' fill='#f78fb3'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50,47 Q47,51 44,49' stroke='#7a4a1f' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50,47 Q53,51 56,49' stroke='#7a4a1f' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='36' y1='43' x2='24' y2='41' stroke='#f7dba7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='46' x2='24' y2='47' stroke='#f7dba7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='43' x2='76' y2='41' stroke='#f7dba7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='46' x2='76' y2='47' stroke='#f7dba7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- left arm raised dancing -->
  <path d='M34,56 Q20,40 24,30' stroke='#f2a65a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='29' r='3.5' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <!-- right arm raised dancing -->
  <path d='M66,56 Q80,42 78,32' stroke='#f2a65a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='31' r='3.5' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <!-- left leg dancing step -->
  <path d='M42,76 Q36,88 28,86' stroke='#f2a65a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='87' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <!-- right leg kicked up -->
  <path d='M58,76 Q68,82 74,74' stroke='#f2a65a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='73' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f2a65a'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#f7dba7'/>
  <!-- tail curling -->
  <path d='M68,68 Q84,64 82,76 Q80,84 74,80' stroke='#f2a65a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M40,26 Q50,22 60,26' stroke='#e08b3f' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M42,55 Q50,52 58,55' stroke='#e08b3f' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#7ef7c8'>
    <circle cx='18' cy='20' r='2.5'/>
    <line x1='20.5' y1='20' x2='20.5' y2='10' stroke='#7ef7c8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <path d='M20.5,10 Q25,11 25,14' stroke='#7ef7c8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='60' r='2.5'/>
    <line x1='84.5' y1='60' x2='84.5' y2='50' stroke='#7ef7c8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <path d='M84.5,50 Q89,51 89,54' stroke='#7ef7c8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  </g>
</svg>
